card.name: Dosing schedule days and intervals
card.fires_on: Commas and units inside infusion schedules, such as the comma after 'Days 1, 8' or 'Week 4', and 'days' or 'hours' after 'every 14' or 'Q 12'. Also a few stray spots in ordinary prose.

modes.label: Commas in day lists
modes.description: The comma after a day or week number in a list of treatment days.

modes.label: Interval units
modes.description: The time unit after a number in an every-N-days or Q-N-hours schedule.
